rationales.1: The bold standfirst delivers the whole finding in plain numbers, each plate carries a prose lead stating what it shows, and the full year-by-year table repeats every value as text, so nothing requires decoding a chart or scrolling.
rationales.2: Each plate is titled by its finding, the missing years are drawn as open shaded bands with no line reaching across, and the heaviest-day plate is explicitly drawn from zero; the season-total plate starts at 550 rather than zero, but says so in its own caption.
rationales.3: Gaps, the instrument seam, the hollow 2019 marker, and the no-attribution scope note appear on every plate and again in the record table; the table's notes column is cut off at mobile width, where the null rows read as bare dashes without their reasons.
rationales.4: Patient local-paper register throughout, with lines like the weir keeping the valley's time for a generation, and the two logged quotes sit as breathers rather than ornament.
rationales.5: Handsome serif setting with consistent plate framing and comfortable measure in both modes and both viewports; the identical four-note key repeated verbatim under all three plates reads as bulk, and the record table clips horizontally on mobile.
rationales.6: The page is a static read with no scroll-driven dependency and no pacing device imposed on the reader, so the base text stands on its own.
rationales.7: The stated idea, reporter's notes written on the record itself, is real and consistently executed through the lettered keys; three separate plates still chart the drift more than they make it felt, so the form trails the journalism.
rationales.8: Reading mechanics are entirely conventional and the only departure is the modest plate-and-key framing, well inside a one-break budget.
rationales.9: Unsensational and specific to this valley, with concrete local detail such as the autumn fair and the lane that floods, rather than weather-story boilerplate.
rationales.10: Every device traces to something the record actually contains: shaded gaps for missing seasons, a hollow marker for the unverified reading, era rules for the two verified windows.
